cause: Asynchronous audit worker added two committed events after pg_dump snapshot but before live-source comparison. The test compared different database instants.
correction: Stop intake APIs, drain pending operations and audit outbox while worker/payments run, stop remaining writers, verify quiescence, then dump/restore/hash-compare.
new_validation: Two independent PostgreSQL E2E repetitions in CI; see current verification.json.

cause: Docker capability detection read CPUCfsQuota instead of the documented CpuCfsQuota JSON field. Historical false values do not demonstrate host lack of support.
correction: Read MemoryLimit, CpuCfsQuota and PidsLimit as strict booleans; record null for unknown. Apply limits only when all three are true.
new_validation: Three unit tests and capability observations in both current E2E receipts.
